data.title: The long corridor
story: This warehouse corridor is really long. Writing forward() six times is tiring!
Use for i in range(n): to repeat a command n times.
data.solution:
for i in range(6):
    forward()
pick_up()
turn_right()
for i in range(3):
    forward()
deliver()

explanation: for i in range(6): repeats the block six times, so the program stays short even in a long corridor. Count the squares first, then write the repeat count.
hints: Count the squares from the robot to the package.
The package is 6 steps ahead; after turning right, the flag is 3 more steps.
